auditor.independence: Session a90c3b249655 (reviewer), served model anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 per this session's harness system prompt, no fallback. Translator: agent coder, model anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 (separate session). Judged from English, the context sidecar, the render sites (chat-remote.ts remoteDeviceLabel/remoteClause/remoteUnreachableClause; chat-sidebar.tsx openedByNote; use-remote-device.ts) and the shipped ur terminology; no MT used.

findings.issue: The fallback is spliced into {device} before a postposition (remote_on_device '{device} پر', remote_on_device_network, and the attachment surfaces via useRemoteSessionDevice). 'کوئی اور ڈیوائس' is the direct case; before پر Urdu needs the oblique 'کسی اور ڈیوائس پر', so the rendered line reads 'کوئی اور ڈیوائس پر' (ungrammatical). Reachable only when the wire carries neither device name nor id (a guard per chat-remote.ts:36-40), hence minor.
findings.suggested_fix: "دوسری ڈیوائس" — case-invariant before any postposition and identical to the shipped fallback ui.canvas.files.remoteDeviceFallback.

checks.placeholders: byte-identical sets to English for all 7 keys (script comparison of {name} sets)
checks.bidi_controls: none in values (U+200E/200F/202A-202E/2066-2069/061C scan); node --test scripts/i18n/ur-activation.test.mjs: 3/3 pass
checks.rtl_rendering: fribidi --rtl on runtime-shaped strings (FSI/PDI around Latin args as bidi.ts isolateArguments adds): '{device} پر · {network}' paints device+پر on the right, middle dot between, network on the left; '{agent} نے “{label}” میں کھولی' keeps the Latin agent and label as intact isolates in RTL order; 'رسائی ممکن نہیں · connect_failed:timeout' keeps the token intact after the dot. U+00B7 and U+201C/U+201D are neutral, take paragraph direction, and are not mirrored; “ ” matches the catalogue convention (214 pairs vs 1 «»).
checks.grammar: کھولی (feminine) agrees with چیٹ, matching shipped opened_by_named/opened_by_anonymous; نے-perfective needs no subject agreement for Latin agent names; پر/میں postpositions correct except UR-SN-1.
checks.terminology: رسائی ممکن نہیں matches ui.chat.page_chrome.status_strip.outcome_unreachable and ui.chat.status.unreachable; '{device} پر' matches ui.canvas.files.remoteOn.
checks.width: ur lengths 11-37 chars vs English 11-31; within the 256px one-line hints
checks.pseudo_locale: not applicable to ur; check-strings, check-duplicates, generate --check and context-parity ok; ledger-check reports this row stale as expected until the integrator updates i18n/ledger.json
